intended_object: The subtype of parameter orbits of a relative subdivision boundary that are not frozen, meaning they are movable. The docstring and its use show it indexes the free coordinates in a general-position perturbation argument inside the Nandakumar–Ramana Rao proof.
explanation: This is a technical device used inside a proof, not a standard mathematical object. It is the subtype `{q : Parameter p B // ¬ IsFrozenParameter p B q}`, which picks out the parameter orbits that are not frozen. The library uses it as the index set for perturbation vectors (`move : MovableParameter p B → Real`) and as the variable type of a polynomial ring (`MvPolynomial (MovableParameter p B) Real`) in a general-position argument. It is internal bookkeeping for one specific proof and has no counterpart in the literature.
